messages.content: Good morning — Northline Care weekly check-in here. How are things going for you this week? If you have your blood pressure cuff nearby, go ahead and send your reading when you get a chance.
138/86. I'm fine. Just so you know these texts always seem to come when I'm in the middle of something.
Appreciated — 138/86 is logged. Any changes to your medications this week, or anything feeling off?

Understood. I'm not able to remove you from this program through this number — to opt out, please contact your care team directly using the number on your welcome letter. Your preference has been noted. Take care.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
